text:
maria: Ran the nightly perf harness after landing the kernel-selector change (prefer_small_kernel=true). Seeing a small but reproducible P99 bump on host_preparse: baseline 25.9ms -> canary 26.5ms (~2.3%, ~600us). P50 up ~1%. KV hit rate unchanged. Profile gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/def456

josh: Which code landed? kernel-selector or batching tweak?

maria: Kernel-selector only (commit 5f3b2e0). It switches to the smaller GPU kernel when batch_size < 16. Suspect it forces a different host-side codepath in the parse-shim that adds a guard/copy around streaming chunk coalescing.

ryan: Share the bench command and the raw numbers?

maria: command and raw:
```
$ bench_host_preparse --tokens=128 --qps=200 --trials=120
baseline: p50=8.3ms p95=18.6ms p99=25.9ms
canary:   p50=8.4ms p95=18.8ms p99=26.5ms
cpu-sample-top:
  24% tokenize::tokenize_bytes
  12% parse_shim::coalesce_chunks
   7% http2::frame_dispatch
```
Looks like ~420us in tokenize and ~180us in coalesce.

anita: Flame graph shows extra memcpy and a short scan loop when selector chooses small-kernel. New fast-path guard seems to allocate/copy into temp when buffer_count>1.

josh: Could selector affect KV codegen or layout? That could cause mem effects. But if KV hit rate is flat it's probably CPU path. Any per-shard KV diffs?

maria: Per-shard KV metrics flat (~98.7% hits). The stack samples point to CPU work in tokenizer and boundary checks in coalesce_chunks.

ryan: I'll reproduce locally toggling kernel selection back to previous behavior (force_previous_kernel=true) and run the bench. Pushing a quick toggle to canary.

ci-bot: Canary deploy started for tag canary-2026-03-21-5f3b2e0

ryan: After toggling to force_previous_kernel=true: p99 returned to 25.9ms (baseline). So the regression is gated by the selector path.

josh: Repro nailed. Two action areas: 1) quantify tokenize cost delta when small-kernel path chosen; 2) change tokenizer to avoid temp copy in common case.

maria: Narrow profiler: extra ~600us breaks down to ~420us in tokenize_bytes (extra single-byte loop) + ~180us in coalesce_chunks (extra boundary checks).

anita: Proposed change: add a fast-check in tokenizer: if buffer_count==1 then skip allocation/copy and operate in-place. Should avoid branch mispred and memcpy. Minimal surface change. Will add unit tests.

kevin: I'll add a metric host_preparse_token_copy_count and alert if it rises >10%. Also dashboard tiles for host_preparse_p99 and kv_cache_hit_rate.

maria: Action items:
- anita: implement no-copy fastcheck in tokenizer + unit tests (owner: anita)
- ryan: run full canary A/B with selector=old vs selector=new and post delta + heap profile (owner: ryan)
- kevin: add token_copy_count metric, baseline dashboard, alert (owner: kevin)
- josh: put a guard in kernel-selector to avoid switching kernel types for batch sizes 8-16 until tokenizer fix is in (owner: josh)

anita: ETA EOD tomorrow for unit tests + microbench.

ryan: Full canary runs queued; will post results here.

ci-bot: Canary job finished: host_preparse_p99 delta (new vs old) = +0.1ms after temporary rollback toggle; full CI artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/1234/artifacts

maria: Thanks team. I'll open a PR to gate the selector change behind a feature-flag and link owners. Moving follow-ups to the perf board. :thumbsup:

josh: Nice quick rollback/test.

kevin: Dashboard + alert entries created for token_copy_count and host_preparse_p99.

maria: Closing thread. Will post PR link in morning.
